gloss_en: "Rosh Bayit" (Head of the House) — Rabbi Nachman's homiletic reading of "Bereishit" (בראשית = ראש בית) in Likutey Moharan II:67, denoting the true tzaddik as the head/master of the house of the world, from whom all generations are drawn and through whom the Temple and the dwellings of Israel are sustained
